title: Second-coordinate second moment
statement: Let $-1\leq \rho\leq 1$ and let $n$ be a positive integer. Under the correlated distribution on pairs of sign vectors that chooses the first uniformly and keeps each coordinate for the second with probability $(1+\rho)/2$, the expected square of the second coordinate of their normalized sum is $1$.
